# rootik

> Dark-first React UI toolkit for dashboards, panels and desktop clients. React 19, zero runtime dependencies besides React, plain CSS with `--rk-*` custom properties in `@layer rootik`. Dark-first ("Graphite & Iris").

The source is the reference: each entry below points at the component (read its `…Props` interface and JSDoc there) and at a story (`src/stories/*.stories.tsx`, open in Ladle with `?story=<id>`) that shows real usage.

## Setup

```tsx
import "rootik/styles.css";
import { RootikProvider, Toaster } from "rootik";

<RootikProvider storageKey="app:appearance">
  <App />
  <Toaster />
</RootikProvider>;
```

With Tailwind v4 declare `@layer theme, base, rootik, components, utilities;` before the imports.

## Rules

- Style through tokens only (`src/tokens.css`: `--rk-accent`, `--rk-surface-1…4`, `--rk-text/-2/-3`, `--rk-radius*`, `--rk-space`); never hard-code colors.
- Props share one vocabulary: `variant`, `size` (`sm | md | lg`), `tone` (`neutral | accent | success | warn | danger | info`), `icon: ReactNode`. Rest props go to the root element; `className` merges.
- Controlled or uncontrolled: `value`/`onChange` or `defaultValue`; open state is `open`/`onOpenChange`.
- Wrap form controls in `Field` (label, hint, error, aria wiring). Icon-only buttons need `label`; status by color needs a text label.
- Translate the kit's strings with `<RootikProvider labels>` (`src/lib/labels.tsx`); appearance via `defaults`, `extensions` or `<Scope values>`.
- Charts take plain arrays; categorical colors come from `seriesColor(i)` in fixed order; accent marks the highlighted datum.

### src/components/bars-list.tsx

- `BarsList` — src/components/bars-list.tsx:29, story `charts--bars-lists`. Top-N as rows: name on a bar sized by value (the remainder hatched), value on the right.

- `BusyOverlay` — src/components/busy-overlay.tsx:19, story `data--busy`. Keeps stale content visible while a region refetches: dims it, makes it `inert` (no clicks, no focus, hidden from assistive tech until done) and shows a spinner.

- `Truncate` — src/components/truncate.tsx:22, story `display--truncation`. Ellipsis that tells when it cuts: the full text appears in a tooltip only while it is actually truncated (measured on resize), so short values don't pop useless tooltips.

### src/theme/provider.tsx

- `RootikProvider` — src/theme/provider.tsx:61. Owns appearance values and writes them as CSS custom properties.
- `Scope` — src/theme/provider.tsx:162, story `utilities--scopes`. Appearance for a subtree (a dense table in a roomy page, a differently accented panel): writes the same CSS vars RootikProvider writes, and `[data-rk-scope]` re-derives every token from them.

### src/theme/settings.tsx

- `AppearanceSettings` — src/theme/settings.tsx:30, story `overview--settings`. Appearance form rendered from the provider's schema — built-in knobs plus project extensions.

### src/lib/highlight.tsx

- `Highlight` — src/lib/highlight.tsx:61, story `display--highlights`. Text with `query` matches highlighted (search results, filtered lists).

## Hooks and utilities

- `announce` — src/lib/announce.ts:26. Speak a message to screen readers without moving focus: "Copied", "Saved", "12 results".
- `cx` — src/lib/cx.ts:1
- `computePosition` — src/lib/floating.tsx:21
- `formatNumber` — src/lib/format.ts:34. Plain or compact ("1.2K") number; the compact suffix goes to `unit`.
- `formatBytes` — src/lib/format.ts:71. File sizes and traffic.
- `formatBitrate` — src/lib/format.ts:80. Network speed in bits per second: "940 Mbps".
- `formatPercent` — src/lib/format.ts:86. Ratio 0..1 as a percentage: 0.425 → "42.5%".
- `formatDuration` — src/lib/format.ts:104. Durations in milliseconds.
- `findRanges` — src/lib/highlight.tsx:18. Ranges of every query word (case-insensitive) in the text under `root`, optionally only inside `selector`.
- `useHighlight` — src/lib/highlight.tsx:42. Marks matches of `query` under `ref` with the CSS Custom Highlight API: no DOM wrapping, so React's tree and text selection stay intact.
- `useControllable` — src/lib/hooks.ts:15. Controlled when `value` is defined, otherwise keeps its own state.
- `mergeRefs` — src/lib/hooks.ts:32
- `cloneTrigger` — src/lib/hooks.ts:44. Clone a trigger element, chaining its own handlers and ref with ours.
- `useLatest` — src/lib/hooks.ts:65. Latest value in a ref: for callbacks used inside long-lived listeners.
- `readStorage` — src/lib/hooks.ts:74. Persist a value in localStorage; storage failures (private mode, quota) are ignored.
- `writeStorage` — src/lib/hooks.ts:84
- `isTypingTarget` — src/lib/hooks.ts:96. The event target takes typed text: plain-key shortcuts must not steal its keystrokes.
- `useHotkeys` — src/lib/hooks.ts:123. Every mounted `useHotkey` that has a description, in registration order.
- `useHotkey` — src/lib/hooks.ts:135. Global shortcut ("mod+k", "shift+?"; `mod` = Ctrl or ⌘).
- `useClipboard` — src/lib/hooks.ts:179. Copy text to the clipboard.
- `useMediaQuery` — src/lib/hooks.ts:199. Live media query match: `useMediaQuery("(max-width: 640px)")`.
- `useElementSize` — src/lib/hooks.ts:214. Content-box size of an element: `const { ref, width, height } = useElementSize()`.
- `useInterval` — src/lib/hooks.ts:233. Run `callback` every `ms` (null stops).
- `usePersistentState` — src/lib/hooks.ts:265. useState persisted in localStorage (JSON).
- `useWindowFocus` — src/lib/hooks.ts:303. Whether the app window has focus (native apps dim their chrome and selection when it doesn't).
- `useScrollSpy` — src/lib/hooks.ts:323. Id of the section currently being read: the last one whose top has passed `offset` px below the top of `root` (the viewport by default).
- `useIndicator` — src/lib/indicator.ts:12. Measures the element matching `selector` inside `container` for a sliding selection indicator.
- `useRovingFocus` — src/lib/roving.ts:38. Roving tab stop for a composite widget (APG toolbar): one Tab stop for the group, arrows move between items, Home/End jump to the ends, and the last focused item is remembered.
- `nextSelection` — src/lib/selection.ts:18. Next selection after activating `key` (pure; `useSelection` wires it to state).
- `useSelection` — src/lib/selection.ts:55. Selection state for lists, tables, trees and grids: single or multiple, Shift ranges, Ctrl/⌘ toggles, select all.
- `prefixOffsets` — src/lib/virtual.ts:11. Start offsets for per-index sizes (prefix sums); `offsets[count]` is the total size.
- `virtualRange` — src/lib/virtual.ts:22. Indices intersecting [offset, offset + height] plus `overscan` on each side.
- `useVirtual` — src/lib/virtual.ts:68. Windowing for long lists, tables and logs: renders only the rows in view.
